title: Chapter card for a counted point
description: Full frame on ink: the point's number large in the highlight colour (440 px) in the middle, the word in paper under it (150 px), and the pack's stored background shapes (brand.json motion_graphics.background.layouts) in the accent at the edges, standing still; the only card that carries them. The cut lands on a frame where the number already rises out of its baseline, the word follows 2 frames later; at the end both sink back. Every chapter card of a video looks the same; only number and word change.
notes: word: the counted point in one or two words ("Recherche", "Punkt zwei"). ground: ink (default) or paper (the accent then takes the number). shapes: false for a plain ground. Use it with "transparent": false (full frame).
